project_name: QR Code Menu & Ordering System for BBQ Restaurant

typography.implementation: Dynamically switch font-family on the document root or container based on active locale (en vs km). When 'km', prioritize Noto Sans Khmer for all text.

primary.description: Chili Red - Used for Primary CTAs, Add to Cart

customer_menu.description: Mobile-first, single column for list view or 2-column grid for dense item view.
customer_menu.spacing: p-4 sm:p-6 pb-32 (to account for sticky cart at bottom)

kds.description: High-density, horizontal layout for tablets. Items flow left to right.

waiter_map.description: Visual representation of tables using CSS grid or flex wrap, with status indicators (Free, Occupied, Needs Staff).

buttons.primary: rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-bold transition-transform hover:scale-[1.02] active:scale-[0.98]
buttons.action_fab: rounded-full shadow-floating bg-white text-black border border-gray-200

cards.menu_item: flex flex-row overflow-hidden bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-soft border border-black/5
cards.kds_ticket: flex flex-col rounded-xl bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 p-4

motion.interactions: Scale down slightly on press (active:scale-95) for all interactive elements to provide tactile feedback.
motion.cart_sheet: Slide up from bottom (Framer Motion: y: 100% -> y: 0) for cart reveal.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 minimum for text. KDS must use text-white on deep gray/black.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 48x48px for all mobile buttons (add to cart, navigation).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-btn').

images.description: Man cooking fish on grill - use for landing or header background
Plate of food and soda - placeholder for actual menu items
Barista using tablet - good for staff login page background

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the customer mobile view using Shadcn UI forms and pure HTML/Tailwind for layouts.
Ensure the locale toggle sets the font-family to Noto Sans Khmer when Khmer is active.
For the KDS (Kitchen Display), strictly adhere to the dark mode palette and high contrast requirements.
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications like 'Order Placed' or 'Staff Called'.
Implement 'Call Staff' and 'Ask for Bill' as prominent Action FABs (Floating Action Buttons) on the customer menu.
On Waiter view, ensure the table map provides immediate visual indication of tables needing assistance.
Build for .js and .jsx files as this is a JS project, avoid .tsx.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts. Prioritize left alignment for content.
Do not use transparent backgrounds for headers/sticky elements; always use backdrop-blur and a semi-transparent fill.
Do not apply `transition: all`. Target specific properties.
Include data-testid on all interactive elements.
Use pill-shaped or slightly rounded UI elements for the customer side, sharp edges for KDS.
